meta.title: Everstead for Professionals | Advisers, Solicitors, Care Homes, HR
meta.description: How Everstead works with financial advisers, solicitors, care homes and HR teams: a family plan your clients, residents and employees actually use, free to start, with an adviser portal for the firms that need one.

hero.title: The families you serve, prepared.
hero.sub: Wills, advice, care and benefits all stop at the same place: a family that still cannot find anything when it matters. Everstead is the practical layer under your work, free for families to start, with a portal for the firms that need one.

audiences.title: Four kinds of professional, one family plan.

items.title: Financial advisers and wealth managers
items.body: See how prepared each client's family really is, with a readiness score, a document review queue and requests, on the client's consent. The conversation moves from "have you done it" to "your family can find it".

items.title: Solicitors and will-writers
items.body: The will is the legal side; Everstead is where the family learns where it is, who to call and what to do first. Clients who arrive organised make probate faster and calmer, and your firm is the one who gave them the tool.

items.title: Care homes and care providers
items.body: Families arrive at admission without the practical details your team needs, and staff carry the questions when a resident dies. Hand every family a free plan and our one-page Emergency Pack; nothing to buy, nothing stored with the home.

items.title: HR and benefits managers
items.body: Bereavement and caring take employees out for months, not days. Offer a wellbeing benefit that gets the practical side organised before it is needed, free to start, with nothing to integrate and no employee data held by the employer.

how.title: Three steps, and the family stays in control.

steps.title: You introduce it
steps.body: A link, a leaflet, or a word at the right moment. Families start free, no card required, and add one thing at a time.

steps.title: They decide what you see
steps.body: Nothing is shared with a firm until the client chooses to. Advisers and solicitors get a portal; care homes and employers never hold the data at all.

steps.title: It stays current
steps.body: Reminders when a document expires, an annual check-in, family sharing with private spaces. The plan is alive long after the meeting.

trust.title: What every partner can say to their clients.
points: UK company, vaults hosted in London under UK GDPR
Free plan with no card, export and deletion at any time
Emergency access opens only after a human check
English and French, with country-aware guidance for the UK and France
No advertising profiles, no selling of data

final.title: Tell us who you serve.
final.body: A 30-minute call is enough to see whether Everstead fits your clients, residents or employees, and what a pilot would look like.
final.note: We are working personally with our first partner firms.
